definitions.gloss: canned salmon; a can of salmon
definitions.explanation: Salmon preserved in a can. A common pantry staple used in rice dishes, salads, and sandwiches; also read さけかん or しゃけかん.

examples.english: To open a can of salmon.

examples.japanese: {鮭缶|さけかん}を{使|つか}って{炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: I make seasoned rice using canned salmon.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}に{備|そな}えて、{鮭缶|さけかん}をいくつか{買|か}い{置|お}きしている。
examples.english: I keep a few cans of salmon stocked in case of a disaster.

notes:
Contraction of {鮭|さけ} (salmon) + {缶|かん} (can). A convenient, long-keeping food often used in home cooking and stockpiled for emergencies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鮭缶|さけかん}を{開|あ}ける: to open a can of salmon
- {鮭缶|さけかん}の{汁|しる}: the liquid in the salmon can

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ツナ{缶|かん}: canned tuna
- {蟹缶|かにかん}: canned crab
